QR_mix1401.why: Track the pure solute. 100 mL at 40% holds 40 mL of it, and 250 mL at 10% holds 25 mL: 65 mL in all. Total volume is 350 mL, so the concentration is 65 / 350 = 18.57%. It lands closer to 10% because there is more of that solution.
traps: This is the mL of solute, not a percent. Divide by the total volume, 350 mL.
